{{Quote|Ortan Cela was cruel, it's true. Petty and insignificant by all accounts. That was the only reason your pitiful master trusted him, and that was his mistake.|[[Veshikk Urk]]'s last words to [[Khem Val]] on Ortan Cela before their final duel|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Ortan Cela''' was a member of the early [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], an apprentice to the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Tulak Hord]]. He would walk with a [[Dashade/Legends|Dashade]] shadow assassin called [[Veshikk Urk]], the greatest rival of fellow assassin [[Khem Val]].<ref name="TOR" />
